welcome.title: Your life, well kept
welcome.body: A private place for your important documents, accounts, instructions and more. So you and the people you care about are prepared, today and tomorrow.

setup.title: Set up your account
setup.subtitle: Your phone number and WhatsApp will get you started. No email needed.
setup.phoneReassure: Your number identifies your account. Passkeys protect access.
setup.otpBody: We sent a code to your WhatsApp number {phone}.
setup.whatsappNote: We only use WhatsApp for notifications. Nothing from your vault is sent there.
setup.passkeyBody: Use Face ID or fingerprint to securely access your account. Your passkey stays on this device and never leaves it.
setup.vaultBody: Your vault is created securely on this device and encrypted. Only you can access it.
setup.lockoutWarning: Without contacts or a recovery kit, losing every device and passkey may lock you out.

people.trustContactDesc: Can help you recover access and confirm a death if needed.
people.beneficiaryDesc: Can receive selected content after you're gone.
people.revokeNote: Revoking prevents future access. Copies already saved cannot be removed.

share.title: Share content
share.afterRule: Two trust contacts must confirm, followed by a 72-hour grace period.
share.permissionViewDesc: You can view and download these documents.

recovery.phoneCannotUnlock: A phone verification code cannot unlock your vault.
recovery.compareCode: Compare this code with your contacts by phone or video call.
recovery.verifiedCheckbox: I verified {name} and the code {code} by phone or video call.

lifeCheck.title: Are you okay?
lifeCheck.body: This is your regular life check. If we don't hear from you, we'll check again later before taking any further steps.
lifeCheck.safety: A missed check never releases your information.

devices.approveOnlyMine: Approve only if this is your computer.
devices.othersNotified: Your other devices have been notified.

getApp.title: Keeplas starts on your phone
getApp.body: Create your account in the Keeplas app, then link this computer by scanning a QR code.
getApp.inviteOnDesktop: Open this invitation on your phone to accept it.
